Abu Rafi sells his dwellings to Sa'd below another offer, as the Prophet said a neighbour has more right for his nearness; gifts go first to the nearest door.
No one should stop his neighbour fixing a wooden peg in his wall, Abu Huraira narrates despite his hearers' reluctance.
Asked which of two neighbours should get her gift, Aisha was told the one whose door is nearer.
Gabriel urged kindness to neighbours till the Prophet thought they would inherit; one whose neighbour fears his harm lacks faith; gifts go to the nearest door, and guests are honoured.
